title: Searching for life on another planet

vocabulary.meaning: living organisms that may exist beyond Earth
examples: Scientists are searching for evidence of extraterrestrial life.
The discovery of extraterrestrial life would change our view of the universe.

vocabulary.meaning: suitable for living things to survive
examples: Researchers look for planets that may be habitable.
Liquid water is one sign that a world could be habitable.

vocabulary.meaning: a planet that moves around a star outside our solar system
examples: Astronomers have discovered thousands of exoplanets.
Some exoplanets may have conditions similar to Earth.

vocabulary.meaning: the layer of gases surrounding a planet
examples: Scientists study a planet's atmosphere for signs of life.
Earth's atmosphere contains oxygen and nitrogen.

vocabulary.meaning: a substance or pattern that may indicate the presence of life
examples: Oxygen can be an important biosignature on another planet.
Researchers look for possible biosignatures in distant atmospheres.

vocabulary.meaning: an instrument used to make distant objects appear closer
examples: The telescope detected a planet around a nearby star.
Powerful telescopes allow scientists to study distant galaxies.
